name: holdout_detector_disjoint_v5
description:
Detector-disjoint holdout subset v5 — 15 cases. Extends v4 (10 cases) with 5 new cases whose anomaly types are OUTSIDE the B3 detector family (duplicate-column / fixed-offset / paired-ratio / cross-sheet-reuse). All 5 new cases are backed by an external correction notice, retraction, or documented PubPeer thread, and all pass the official validator + a live B3 (l1_relationship_verifier, explicit_range_only=True) run confirming no_flag. Purpose: raise N from 10 to 15 so the Q3 non-leakage argument moves from a directional probe (single-case swing ~10pp) to weakly confirmatory (single-case swing ~6.7pp).

New cases (v4 -> v5):
  np_grassland_pcoa       (misaligned_records / #4): PCoA ordination columns pasted out of register with SampleID; different-species-richness rows share identical coordinates. Dryad v4 vs corrected v6, author-confirmed.
  soilwarming_p_impute    (undisclosed_imputation / #8): CO2-leak outliers silently replaced by within-group means -> scattered 15-sig-fig-identical TOP values. Dryad v7 vs corrected v12 (imputed cells -> NA), author-confirmed.
  drosophila_chillcoma    (sample_count_mismatch / #7): recorded per-group n (14-223) contradicts stated design n=100/group; 20C male n=14. PubPeer-documented.
  parthenium_antioxidant  (value_substitution + sample_count_mismatch / #4;#7): per-larva SOD/CAT/LPO values copy-pasted between larvae within a column (some with a single altered digit); unique SOD/CAT/LPO = 311/301/291 of 350. PubPeer-documented.
  mindfulness_dyads       (provenance_mismatch / silent data replacement; #1;#3): child EEG FPN/CON/DMN triples duplicated across dyads; data file silently replaced ~1 month after PubPeer flag, no changelog. Anchored on the cross-version silent replacement (0.001894673 -> 0.000447...), out-of-family as anchored.

Anomaly type breakdown (9 distinct types across 15 cases):
  label_swap x2:                        ncb_cav2, natcomm_florido_tac2
  misaligned_records x2:                ncb_clonalfish, np_grassland_pcoa
  mislabeled_panel:                     ncb_lphn3
  assignment_inconsistency x2:          ncb_radioligand, ncb_nickelate
  pseudoreplication:                    ncb_spp1
  provenance_mismatch x3:               elife_neurexin_fig1b, natcomm_nguyen_mirna, mindfulness_dyads
  figure_vs_sourcedata_count_mismatch:  natcomm_petruk_tlr
  undisclosed_imputation:               soilwarming_p_impute
  sample_count_mismatch:                drosophila_chillcoma
  value_substitution:                   parthenium_antioxidant

Validator: 15/15 pass. B3 detector FAR: 0/15 (case-level, after self-comparison guard).
